matter.caption: In re the Marriage of Whitfield
matter.type: Marital dissolution with an operating-company sale
matter.analystRole: Financial expert supporting counsel; no attest services performed
matter.description: Cedar Ridge Contracting sold to a regional homebuilder in three closings. Both parties assert competing figures for the divisible estate. This case teaches the claims-register method: nothing is accepted on assertion, every closed row carries a primary-source receipt, evidence is tiered by strength, and an independent pass tries to break the package before it is delivered.

notes: Equal-split rows do not move the gap between the parties. Identify them early so the reader stops re-litigating them.
